title: Villager A Wants to Save the Villainess at All Costs: The Trench, the Sky, and the Ice Princess
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Allen, an eight-year-old from a poor family in a royal capital, recalls a past life and realizes he lives inside a dating-sim game in which a war will destroy the capital, killing him and his mother. Though he is not a character in the game, he uses his knowledge and hard work to change fate, aiming to save his mother and the game's doomed villainess, Anastasia. Later chapters turn toward politics and war.
life_message: Hard work and determination can let an ordinary commoner change a fate that seems fixed.
